Tooltip_DelHeat_Pipe: Carries the hot water from a boiler house to the heat units; does not join a cold water pipe. Laid one by one, or as a run: hold the button and drag. Above the ground it needs no floor: lay it out into the air from an upper floor, or press R and lay it a level up from the ground. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_ColdPipe: Steel with a bluish-grey tint. Carries the cold water from a water intake to the boiler houses and the water units; does not join a heating pipe. Laid like a heating pipe, on the ground or a level up. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Support: A steel lattice post one level high. Stands on the ground under a pipe laid a level up. Only for the look. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Radiator: Warms a room when a heat unit with hot water is within range. Needs no pipe of its own. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Inlet: Stands at a wall of a house on the end of a heating pipe and feeds the radiators around it. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_WaterUnit: Stands at a wall of a house on a cold water pipe from a water intake. Keeps a tank of water and tops up the sinks, toilets and baths around it; nothing needs to be plumbed. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Pump: Sends the water further along the pipe. Carries its own length of pipe and joins pipes only at its two ends: turn it along the line. Needs electricity. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Intake: 2x2 cells by a river or a lake: pumps water into the cold water pipes to the boiler houses and water units. A pipe joins it only at its outlet. Needs electricity. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Boiler: 2x3 cells: burns fuel and heats the water for a whole neighbourhood. Pipes join it only at the two outlets by its tank: the bluish-grey one takes the cold water pipe, the other gives the hot water to the heating pipe. Built only by the staff of a heat supply organization. Right-click it: Place. A pipe wrench is needed.
